svg.title: Pads for a spring-pin programming cable
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view, after one cable maker's published footprint for a six-pin cable without retaining legs. Six round copper pads 0.787 mm in diameter sit in two rows of three on a 1.27 mm grid, numbered 1, 3, 5 along the bottom row and 2, 4, 6 along the top. Three non-plated holes 0.991 mm in diameter locate the cable: one on the pin-1 end, 2.54 mm from the center on the center line, and two on the far end, 2.54 mm from the center and 1.016 mm above and below the center line, so the cable fits only one way. The area between the rows is a keep-out with no tracks or vias, and nothing else comes within 0.5 mm of a pad. Traces leave each pad outwards, up or down. The pads get no paste.

g.text: Keep-out: no tracks or vias between the rows
Nothing else within 0.5 mm of a pad
Contact pads: no paste, mask cleared
One at one end, two at the other: fits one way only
Drawn to scale, after one cable maker's footprint.
Use the exact footprint for the cable you'll use.
